observation.command:
cd /workspace && echo "=== no keycloak/adminer/otel services in checked-in compose (local KC is external) ==="; grep -icE 'keycloak:|adminer:|grafana:|loki:|prometheus:|otel-collector:' compose.yaml compose.override.yaml
echo "=== compose service names (the only local infra components) ==="; grep -nE '^  [a-z-]+:$' compose.yaml
echo "=== app state file written by canonical runner? (explains app:null) ==="; find / -path /proc -prune -o -name 'local-app-state*.json' -print 2>/dev/null | head; find /workspace -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -l '"profile":"local-builder"' 2>/dev/null | grep -viE node_modules | head
echo "=== readiness keycloak target (from env) ==="; tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/22747/environ 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_BASE_URL' | head
